# TubeForge agents — job descriptions

One file per agent. Each one lists the agent's role, actions, TubeForge instructions, mission, context, input, responsibilities, process, output, handoff, and security and misuse guardrails.

The facts come from `docs/AI_AGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md` §4. The prompts the agents actually run are in `workers/tubeforge_agents/prompts/`.

| Agent | Mission | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [A01 — Master YouTube Orchestrator](A01_ORCHESTRATOR.md) | Drive every workflow state machine; decide the next step; create approval requests; enqueue agent tasks. | Built (Phase 5) |
| [A02 — Niche Discovery](A02_NICHE_DISCOVERY.md) | Propose niche candidates with criterion-level scores, evidence and confidence from permitted non-YouTube sources (ADR-0015). | Built (Phase 6) |
| [A03 — Trend Intelligence](A03_TREND_INTELLIGENCE.md) | Detect rising topics for a channel's pillars from permitted sources with expiry. | Built (Phase 6) |
| [A04 — Competitor Research](A04_COMPETITOR_RESEARCH.md) | Owner-initiated single-item lookups of public channel/video metadata (no aggregation). | Built (Phase 6) |
| [A05 — Keyword Research](A05_KEYWORD_RESEARCH.md) | Suggest search phrases for a channel/idea using non-YouTube evidence (Wikipedia, feeds, Trends alpha) and language knowledge. | Built (Phase 6) |
| [A06 — Channel Strategy](A06_CHANNEL_STRATEGY.md) | Turn a shortlisted niche into a channel blueprint (positioning, audience, pillars, formats, growth strategy, risks). | Built (Phase 6) |
| [A07 — Channel Branding](A07_CHANNEL_BRANDING.md) | Name ideas, description, brand identity, logo/banner briefs, palette, fonts (licensed list only). | Built (Phase 6) |
| [A08 — Idea Generation](A08_IDEA_GENERATION.md) | Generate original, varied video ideas aligned to pillars; flag similarity to channel catalogue. | Phase 7 |
| [A09 — Research](A09_RESEARCH.md) | Produce a cited research brief for an approved idea. | Phase 7 |
| [A10 — Fact-Checking](A10_FACT_CHECKING.md) | Classify each claim in brief/script as supported/unsupported/contradicted/opinion with sources. | Phase 7 |
| [A11 — Scriptwriting](A11_SCRIPTWRITING.md) | Write a human-sounding, engaging script in the channel language: deliver the title/thumbnail promise in the intro, a 10–15 s opening hook, mid-video re-hooks, honest curiosity and suspense where they fit, storytelling, and explicit slots for the owner's own insight — every open loop paid off. | Phase 7 |
| [A12 — Storyboard](A12_STORYBOARD.md) | Split the locked script into scenes with narration, visual instructions, on-screen text and durations. | Phase 8 |
| [A13 — Visual Creative](A13_VISUAL_CREATIVE.md) | Choose visual treatment per scene (template, chart, kinetic text, owner media, stock suggestion) and produce render specs. | Phase 8 |
| [A14 — AI Image Generation](A14_AI_IMAGE.md) | Generate images via an enabled image provider (disabled by default — ADR-0010) or render procedural images locally. | Phase 8 |
| [A15 — Voiceover](A15_VOICEOVER.md) | Produce narration per scene: owner recordings (cleanup), owner clone (OpenVoice/Chatterbox), or licensed TTS (Kokoro/Piper). | Phase 8 |
| [A16 — Video Production](A16_VIDEO_PRODUCTION.md) | Auto-assemble timeline JSON from storyboard, visuals, narration, music; produce proxy. | Phase 9 |
| [A17 — Video Editing](A17_VIDEO_EDITING.md) | Apply owner edit instructions to the timeline (e.g., 'tighten intro', 'swap scene 4 visual'); final render. | Phase 9 |
| [A18 — Thumbnail Design](A18_THUMBNAIL_DESIGN.md) | Create ≥3 thumbnail concepts and render them (procedural composition, owner photo, frame grab from own render). | Phase 10 |
| [A19 — YouTube SEO](A19_YOUTUBE_SEO.md) | Produce titles, description, tags, hashtags, chapters, playlists and the AI-disclosure assessment. | Phase 10 |
| [A20 — Caption & Subtitle](A20_CAPTIONS.md) | Create caption tracks by aligning script to narration (faster-whisper), fallback transcription. | Phase 10 |
| [A21 — Copyright Auditor](A21_COPYRIGHT_AUDITOR.md) | Verify every asset in the final cut has a valid rights record allowed for this channel. | Phase 11 |
| [A22 — YouTube Policy Auditor](A22_POLICY_AUDITOR.md) | Assess Community Guidelines, advertiser-friendliness, YPP inauthentic/reused risk, misleading metadata, synthetic disclosure, made-for-kids presence. | Phase 11 |
| [A23 — Video Quality Auditor](A23_QUALITY_AUDITOR.md) | Technical QC: resolution, fps, codec, loudness, A/V sync, black/frozen frames, silence, caption sync, Shorts ≤ 180 s & aspect, watermark detection on external edits. | Phase 9 |
| [A24 — Upload](A24_UPLOAD.md) | Execute approved uploads via SafeYouTubeClient (resumable, idempotent) and post-upload steps. | Phase 12 |
| [A25 — Publishing & Scheduling](A25_PUBLISHING.md) | Plan publish times within caps/quiet hours; track scheduled → published; reschedule only with new approval. | Phase 12 |
| [A26 — Analytics](A26_ANALYTICS.md) | Fetch own-channel analytics daily; maintain snapshots; 30-day authorization re-check. | Phase 13 |
| [A27 — Growth Optimization](A27_GROWTH.md) | Turn own analytics into evidence-backed suggestions (topics, hooks, length, posting time). | Phase 13 |
| [A28 — Comment Moderation](A28_COMMENT_MODERATION.md) | Suggest replies / spam flags for own-channel comments (feature off by default). | Phase 13 |
| [A29 — Notification](A29_NOTIFICATION.md) | Route events to in-app/Telegram/email with preferences, quiet hours, dedup and digests. | Phase 14 |
| [A30 — Security Auditor](A30_SECURITY_AUDITOR.md) | Daily posture checks and anomaly detection on security events. | Phase 11 |
| [A31 — System Auditor](A31_SYSTEM_AUDITOR.md) | Audit agent behaviour: permission violations, failure rates, usage spikes, stuck jobs, chain integrity. | Phase 11 |
| [A32 — Free-Tier Cost & Usage Monitor](A32_COST_MONITOR.md) | Track every provider vs limits; pause at limits; forecast; detect paid-tier indicators; re-verify reminders. | Built (Phase 5) |
